we have identified a large family of ATP‐binding cassette (ABC) transporters in Arabidopsis thailiana.
we have identified 60 ABC protein genes in the Arabidopsis genome, and have assigned 89 of the ABC domains to these genes.

the identification, cloning, expression and analysis of the Arabidopus thaliana ABC transport proteins and the elucidation of the role of these proteins in higher plants.
the identification of the ABC proteins in Arabidopsis thalina and the assignment of their functional roles in the plant.
the characterization of the Arabidopis ABC transporters.
